scope: Shared staged student curriculum may advance one sole unqualified student after peers stay frozen for five completed epochs.
counting: Only epochs in which the same full peer group was frozen throughout training and remains qualified at validation count; first freezing epoch excluded. Recording reuse counts for this epoch timeout, not ordinary plateau gates.
guards: Two or more holdouts never force progression
No forced progression after maximum difficulty
checkpoint_behavior: Timeout state persists with normal/stage recovery for the same group; old checkpoints lacking fields begin at zero. Standard stage-best model, optimizer and EMA restoration remains active.
limitations: Existing Python training processes must restart/recover to load the new rule.
No long training run started or altered.
